english.title: Fail to provide Secretary of State or Water Services Regulation Authority with information concerning transfer scheme
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a company, as an appointee, without reasonable excuse, failed to provide the

(A)_[Secretary of State]_
(B)_[Water Services Regulation Authority]_

with all such information and other assistance as

(C)_[he]_

english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 2(7) and (8) of Schedule 2 to the Water Industry Act 1991.
